name: museum-relic-stamp
title_zh: 一套能续画的馆藏印章海报生成器，纸纹印色已调好
tagline_zh: 青铜、书画、织物都吃。象牙纸底、可选做旧印泥、朱砂钤记、中英排版一次给齐。不用自己调纸纹，拖图进来就出同系列视觉。
tagline_en: Bronze, painting, textile—all in. Ivory paper, distressed ink options, vermilion seals, bilingual layout. Drag in.
desc_en: Generate a complete museum-relic stamp poster from one supplied artifact image, using fixed ivory paper, selectable distressed theme ink, vermilion seals, and bilingual editorial styling. Use for 博物馆文物图章、馆藏海报或同系列视觉续作；适用于青铜器、陶瓷、玉器、书画、雕塑、织物等，不限圆明园或十二生肖。
why_zh: 把馆藏海报的工艺变量——纸、印泥、钤记、双语排版——固化成可选项，而不是让用户从零调。
why_en: It bakes the craft variables—paper, ink, seal, bilingual type—into presets, so sequels stay blood-related instead of looking.
limit_zh: 只认单张文物正面图，多角度或场景照需先裁好；输出是A4竖版海报，不生成展签或三维模型；纸纹固定象牙色。
limit_en: Single frontal artifact photo only; multi-angle shots need pre-cropping. Output is A4 portrait poster—no labels or 3D models. Ivory paper fixed.
title_en: Museum stamp poster generator with preset paper & ink
